tickets.title: Set up self-employed retirement plan
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a client cannot access an approved account portal, custodian site, or secure document vault. Confirm identity, determine whether the issue is username, password, device, multi-factor authentication, locked account, or outdated contact information, and document the resolution path before closing the request. Lena Copperwisp reported that authentication codes for the shared document vault are still routing to Marcus Copperwisp's mobile number, preventing her from retrieving estate and account records; restore her individual access through verified channels.

tickets.title: Review beneficiary update request
tickets.text:
Review criteria:
- Confirm which accounts, policies, plans, or registration types require beneficiary review.
- Compare current beneficiary records against the client’s stated intent and estate planning notes.
- Verify full legal names, relationships, percentage allocations, contingent beneficiaries, and per stirpes or per capita elections where applicable.
- Confirm allocations total correctly and do not conflict with account or custodian rules.
- Identify whether spouse consent, trustee information, minor beneficiary handling, or legal review is needed.

Evidence to collect:
- Current custodian or plan beneficiary record
- Client authorization or signed beneficiary form
- Relevant trust name and trustee details, if a trust is named
- Estate planning summary or attorney instruction, if available
- Confirmation notice or screenshot after processing

Document any discrepancy, missing signature, or follow-up required before marking the update complete. The client file review showed Marcus Copperwisp is still listed as primary beneficiary on Lena Copperwisp's IRA and term life policy records at Velvet Acorn Custody and Moonbadger Insurance, while the estate summary describes the children (Eva and Finn Copperwisp) and trust provisions as the next intended backstop.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up to review those beneficiary records is due 2023-10-20.

tickets.text: Request missing tax forms, prior-year return details, realized gain/loss reports, charitable contribution records, and any estimated tax payment confirmations needed for planning or CPA coordination. tickets.title: Review concentrated position
tickets.text:
Complete the following checks:
- Identify the position, account location, cost basis, holding period, and percentage of total investable assets.
- Confirm whether the holding is employer stock, inherited stock, restricted equity, a legacy position, or a tax-sensitive lot.
- Review unrealized gain or loss, dividend exposure, liquidity needs, and any trading restrictions or blackout windows.
- Evaluate tax-aware diversification options, including staged sales, gifting, charitable strategies, exchange funds if appropriate, or hedging considerations.
- Compare concentration risk against the client’s financial plan, retirement income needs, and risk tolerance.
- Document recommended next steps, required approvals, and any CPA or legal coordination needed before transactions. The position is Paper Otter Technologies stock worth about $510,000 with an estimated cost basis of $96,000 in the joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody; Lena Copperwisp said the concentration feels more uncomfortable now that household income has changed.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up to review the concentrated stock position is due 2023-11-03.
